coverage: Read complete native DRC, ERC, netlist and geometry records; inspected saved PCB and project constraints/exclusions.
Independently reran DRC without refilling copper: reproduced the 13 excluded error entries and zero unconnected items.
Compared 694 numbered PCB pad instances against native XML net assignments; found no mismatches.
Measured J1 mounting holes and generated separate plated/unplated drill files.

Inspected three flagged ground reliefs and their additional trace connections; checked CAN2 connectivity, DNP termination population and selected power/return geometry. Commands, versions and results are recorded in review-work/physical/experiments/README.md.

findings.condition: Direct drill export of the saved PCB places five anonymous J1 mounting holes in the plated-through-hole file.

evidence.locator: /violations/132 through /violations/141: five padstack and five annular_width entries, all excluded=true
mechanical_holes: positions, diameters and nominal_annulus_mm calculations
T10 and T12 drill hits: two 2.2 mm holes and three 4.0 mm holes
Plated hole tool counts; total unplated holes count 0

findings.mechanism: Each circular pad diameter equals its drill diameter: 4.0/4.0 mm or 2.2/2.2 mm. Nominal annulus (pad minus drill diameter)/2 is therefore zero, despite the plated drill classification.
findings.reasoning: Native geometry, DRC and independent drill export agree on the zero-annulus PTH representation. The saved exclusions acknowledge these violations but provide no rationale. Plating intent and finished-hole fit remain unverified. These are no-net mounting holes; electrical failure or fabrication rejection is not established.
findings.title: J1 mounting holes retain zero-annulus PTH geometry

limitations: Saved fills only; no refill comparison, fabricated-board continuity test, powered measurement or behavioral simulation.
R36 and R37 are both 120-ohm DNP. Module/harness termination, assembled CAN2 resistance and dynamic CAN operation were not established.
No ampacity, load simultaneity, fault coordination, temperature-rise, junction-temperature or cooling qualification; width alone was not treated as qualification.
Connector drawings, fabrication tolerances, finished-hole fit, complete land-pattern validation and 3D module/enclosure clearances were not verified.
The independent DRC environment had different library resolution; geometric error entries reproduced, while library-warning counts differed.
Not every ERC warning received component-specific adjudication. Automotive transients, ignition energy, wideband stability, EMC and integrated FOME-MC coverage remain omitted.
